verdict.rationale: Plaid documents Identity Verification webhooks you can subscribe to for real-time alerts, with STEP_UPDATED, STATUS_UPDATED and RETRIED events. That covers reacting to lifecycle and outcome changes without polling. missing for 10: evidence that webhooks are cryptographically signed or verifiable, an explicit mapping of statuses (created/processing/verified/requires-input) to webhook payloads, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
